ImageDescription.value:
A close-up view of a load cell strain-gauge module removed from a digital weighing scale.

This component detects force by measuring minute deformations in the metal plate, which are converted into electrical signals by strain gauges embedded inside the sensor.

Load cells like this are widely used in weighing systems, industrial measurement devices, laboratory balances, and force-sensing applications.
